itens.trecho: Um filme sólido, muito bem feito, mas com algumas fragilidades. Este filme situa-se no Norte de França, durante o desembarque aliado na Normandia e as semanas que o sucederam.

Great WWII war action in France, but too much of the drama is weak RELEASED IN 1998 and directed by Steven Spielberg, "Saving Private Ryan" (SPR) is about the Normandy invasion and its immediate aftermath from June 6-16, 1944.

I don't think I can recall any Hollywood film that depicts the atrocities of the D-Day landings as effectively as this does at the start.
